title: Kth Smallest Subarray Sum
summary: Given an integer array of length n and an integer k, find the kth smallest sum of any contiguous subarray.
statement: Given an integer array of length n and an integer k, find the kth smallest sum of any contiguous subarray. A subarray sum is the total of its elements.
constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 20000 and every value is positive.
Sort the sums of all nonempty contiguous subarrays conceptually and return the one-based kth value.
hints: Because values are positive, a sliding window counts subarrays with sum at most a threshold in linear time.
For each right endpoint, shrink the left edge until the sum fits, then add the number of valid starts.
Binary-search the smallest threshold whose count reaches k.
The count is monotonic in the threshold, and the first threshold with at least k sums is exactly the kth sorted sum.
editorial: The count is monotonic in the threshold, and the first threshold with at least k sums is exactly the kth sorted sum.

tests.explanation: The sorted sums are 1,2,3,3,4,6, so the fourth is three.
Counting sums by threshold shows that the seventh smallest sum is eight.
